summary: American Water Works Company filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of equity interests in regulated water and wastewater system assets from Nexus Regulated Utilities, LLC (a subsidiary of Nexus Water Group, Inc.) for ~$315 million cash, subject to adjustment. The assets are located across eight U.S. states with an estimated aggregate rate base of ~$200 million, adding ~47,000 customer connections and ~70 employees. The purchase agreement was dated May 19, 2025 and all required regulatory approvals were obtained before closing. The cash purchase price was funded from operations and existing liquidity. Watch for post-close integration and any earnout adjustments.
